description: This file defines utility functions to find items within an array based on their UUIDs, specifically implementing 'FindItem' and 'SureFindItem' functions which operate on items conforming to the ItemInterface.

methods.name: export function FindItem<I extends ItemInterface = ItemInterface>(items: I[], uuid: string): I |/ FindItem
methods.description: Searches an array of items for an item with a matching UUID, returning the item or undefined if not found.

methods.name: export function SureFindItem<I extends ItemInterface = ItemInterface>(items: I[], uuid: string):/ SureFindItem
methods.description: Finds an item with a matching UUID, asserting the item exists and returning it.

ctags.name: FindItem
ctags.pattern: /^export function FindItem<I extends ItemInterface = ItemInterface>(items: I[], uuid: string): I |/
